title: The Spoofer's Discount
description: Drive the Proof-of-Learning trap: a logged training trajectory, audited top-Q by re-execution against a tolerance δ. Forge the run and it still passes — the forger tuned every interval under δ for 3% of training cost. Tighten δ to catch it and the honest node fails first.
controls: tap an interval bar to inspect its re-execution error
